🎳 AI Bowling Ball Assistant

Planned feature. This workspace is designed for coaches to ask bowling-equipment questions when evaluating options for a bowler.

AI connection not configured yet.

The GitHub Pages version is a static website and cannot securely call an AI service by itself. This interface is ready for the cloud/API phase. Until then, the button can prepare the question for use in ChatGPT.

Useful information to include

Ball weight and model; RG, differential and intermediate differential when applicable; coverstock and surface; bowler speed/rev rate; PAP; axis rotation/tilt if known; handedness; lane condition; current equipment reaction; and the motion the bowler wants.

Equipment guidance note

AI estimates are a coaching reference, not a substitute for measuring the bowler or checking the manufacturer's drilling/layout guidance. Actual reaction depends on the bowler, lane condition, surface, coverstock, core and drilling.
